screen.veinminerplus.config.title: VeinMinerPlus Server Settings
screen.veinminerplus.config.normal_limit: Maximum blocks broken by one normal or area chain. Range: 32-32767.
screen.veinminerplus.config.normal_speed: Maximum normal-chain blocks broken per server tick. Range: 1-384.
Maximum total blocks broken by one blast chain. Range: 32-32767.
Maximum blast blocks broken per server tick. Range: 1-512. High values may reduce TPS.
screen.veinminerplus.config.blast_distan: Maximum distance searched from each discovered block. Range: 3-128.
screen.veinminerplus.config.low_tps.desc: Warns when server TPS drops below this value and may reduce the radius. Range: 5-20.
screen.veinminerplus.config.manhattan.de: Enabled uses Manhattan distance with a diamond-shaped range. Disabled uses Euclidean distance with a spherical range.
When enabled, low TPS halves the active blast radius, down to a minimum of 3.
screen.veinminerplus.config.hunger.descr: When enabled, chain mining consumes hunger. When disabled, it preserves the pre-mine food, saturation, and exhaustion values.
screen.veinminerplus.config.mode.descrip: Click to cycle the current player's chain mode and save it as the server default.
screen.veinminerplus.config.subtitle: Server rules; changes affect every player
screen.veinminerplus.config.whitelist.de: Rules support block IDs, * wildcards, and #block tags. Separate with commas, semicolons, or new lines. + adds the aimed block's ore tags; - removes its ore tags and exact ID, or the last rule without a block hit.
message.veinminerplus.config_permission: You need permission level 2 to open VeinMinerPlus settings
